prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production Unity 2.5D game enemy animation sprite sheet. Input image is ONLY the identity/silhouette and exact VIEW direction reference. Redraw this same Spitter, not a new creature. Materials: matte dark rock brown armor, warm gray-white sinewy limbs, restrained amber eye slit, clean painterly pre-rendered 3D style matching AlienPurge. Camera fixed elevated 45 degrees, soft upper-left light. Four-legged acid spitting alien with brown rocky hood/head armor, pale gray sinewy FOUR limbs, one very large pale yellow-green veined throat/belly bladder hanging under chest, smaller brown dorsal plates. Preserve the reference's bulbous ventral green sac silhouette; the sac is at FRONT underside, not an orange/purple back organ. Single head, no extra sacs.
CRITICAL DIRECTION: RIGHT profile facing screen right, nose at right edge of body and tail at left; keep this exact direction in EVERY pose, no turns.
Layout: EXACTLY FOUR columns and 6 rows, 24 separate full character drawings. PORTRAIT canvas with width:height ratio 4:6, each equal square cell contains one complete creature within its central 70%, generous fully transparent gutters all around. No silhouettes touch, no cropped feet, no detached bits. Read frames left to right then top to bottom. Rows1-2: EIGHT sequential WALK frames with real four-leg alternating gait, heavy green throat bladder follows subtly, stable body. Row3: FOUR IDLE breath poses with gentle sac motion. Row4: FOUR SPIT WINDUP frames: feet brace, front head lifts slightly, green throat bladder gradually inflates and tenses, mouth opens at final frame. Row5: FOUR SPIT/RECOVERY frames: FIRST frame mouth opens and throat bladder squeezes, then head recoils, bladder relaxes and mouth closes. Do NOT paint the projectile or a detached liquid stream (Unity owns it). Row6: FOUR non-explosive DEATH frames: legs buckle, hood/head rests on floor, green bladder slackens and dims without rupturing, eye goes dark.
Every frame holds the EXACT SAME camera direction, identity, proportions, four legs and plate count. Real joint motion, no duplicate frames or whole-body-only transforms. Anchor feet at the same baseline and body at same center in each cell. Empty pixels true alpha 0, including holes between legs; no solid background, no floor, no cast shadow, no text/labels/grid, no VFX/projectiles. Render clean silhouette edges.
